tokenHelp: Enter the setup token that the installer printed when it finished. It proves you're the person who installed D-cubby.
defaultLanguageHint: Used for everyone unless they choose another language.
logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB. You can change it later.
logoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
logoSize: The logo must be smaller than 2 MB.
ownerHelp: You'll be the owner: you can manage everything, including users and settings.
retentionHelp: Deleted files stay in the recycle bin for this many days, so they can be restored. After that they're removed for good.
setupFailed: Setup didn't finish. Check the details and try again.
integrationsHelp: These settings come from the installer. Test each one you set up. To change them, run ./install.sh --reconfigure on the server.
inviteHelp: Add the people who'll use the library. You can also do this later in Settings → Users.
doneHelp: Your asset library is ready. Start by uploading some files.
